tagline.en: The outer bypass of New York City, finished 35 years late
tagline.zh: 纽约市外围绕行线，迟了三十五年才建成

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.en: I-95 and the New Jersey Turnpike at Edison, New Jersey
start.zh: 新泽西州爱迪生，与 I-95 及新泽西收费高速相接

end.en: I-95 at Rye, Westchester County, New York
end.zh: 纽约州威彻斯特县赖伊，与 I-95 相接

en: I-287 is the wide bypass of New York City: a half-circle that leaves I-95 in central New Jersey, swings north-west around Somerville, Morristown and the Ramapo Mountains, crosses into New York at Suffern, runs east across the Hudson and finishes back on I-95 at Rye. The even hundreds digit is honest — it leaves its parent route and returns to it eighty miles later, having kept long-distance traffic thirty miles clear of Manhattan.

It is really two roads. West and north of Suffern it is a free state highway through the New Jersey suburbs; across Rockland and Westchester it runs with the New York State Thruway and then becomes the Cross-Westchester Expressway. The federal log counts 67.54 miles in New Jersey and 13.1 in New York, the New York figure covering the Cross-Westchester section rather than the Thruway concurrency.
zh: I-287 是纽约市外围那条大绕行线：一个半圆，自新泽西中部离开 I-95，向西北绕过萨默维尔、莫里斯敦与拉马波山，在萨弗恩进入纽约州，再向东跨过哈得孙河，最后在赖伊回到 I-95。偶数百位在这里是诚实的——它离开母线，八十英里之后又回到母线，其间把长途交通挡在了距曼哈顿三十英里之外。
它其实是两条路。萨弗恩以西、以北，是穿过新泽西郊区的免费州级公路；在罗克兰与威彻斯特两县，它先与纽约州收费高速共线，随后变成横威彻斯特快速路。联邦路线名录记新泽西 67.54 英里、纽约 13.1 英里，纽约那部分算的是横威彻斯特段，而不是与收费高速共线的里程。

en: Construction started in 1958 in Somerset County and worked outwards. By the mid-1960s the road existed from the Turnpike as far north-east as US 202 at Montville, and there it stopped for twenty-eight years. Organised opposition began in 1965, over pollution, flooding, wells and the destruction of communities in the road's path, and eleven municipalities threatened to sue over every alignment the state proposed.

FHWA approved the so-called central alignment — twenty miles from Montville to Route 17 at Mahwah, along the edge of the Ramapo Mountains — on 3 September 1982. Final permits from the Army Corps of Engineers followed in 1988, and the link opened on 19 November 1993, eight months ahead of the schedule set then, with Rockland County still litigating over the wetlands permit as the ribbon was cut. The interchange with the Thruway at Suffern was finished the following year.
zh: 工程于 1958 年在萨默塞特县开工，由内向外推进。到 1960 年代中期，这条路已从收费高速一直修到东北方蒙特维尔的 US 202，然后就在那里停了二十八年。有组织的反对始于 1965 年，理由涉及污染、洪水、水井以及沿线社区被拆毁；州里每提出一个线位方案，都有十一个市镇扬言起诉。
联邦公路管理局于 1982 年 9 月 3 日批准了所谓「中线方案」——自蒙特维尔至马瓦的 17 号公路，沿拉马波山边缘走二十英里。陆军工程兵团的最终许可于 1988 年发出，这段连接线于 1993 年 11 月 19 日通车，比当时定下的工期提前八个月；剪彩当天，罗克兰县仍在就湿地许可提起诉讼。萨弗恩与收费高速的立交次年完工。

why.en: The sections built between 1958 and the mid-1960s were let contract by contract by New Jersey and New York and no consolidated total has been published for them.

label.zh: 缺口路段设计通行能力

timeline.en: Construction begins in Somerset County, New Jersey.
timeline.zh: 工程在新泽西州萨默塞特县开工。

timeline.en: Organised opposition begins in northern New Jersey and stops the project for a generation.
timeline.zh: 新泽西州北部出现有组织的反对，工程停摆一代人之久。

timeline.en: FHWA approves the central alignment through the Ramapo Mountains.
timeline.zh: 联邦公路管理局批准穿越拉马波山的中线方案。

timeline.en: The 20-mile missing link opens, completing the bypass 35 years after work started.
timeline.zh: 20 英里缺口路段通车，绕行线在开工 35 年后建成。
